sentence: Sein bisschen Geld ist schnell ausgegeben.

notes.rationale: The possessive sein is a meaningful determiner, not an article, so it stays a target of its own beside bisschen (#734's 2026-09-30 decision).

Quantity bisschen is one Lexeme PRON bisschen in every use (de/quantifier-by-use, #734's 2026-09-30 decision); sein stays outside it. Its Attestation waits for the follow-up that settles article evidence, agreement and case from reviewed examples; no nominal case is invented for a degree use.
Geld is what bisschen quantifies, its own target (de/quantifier-by-use).
ausgeben builds its perfect with haben, so ist … ausgegeben is a state: copular sein stays apart (de/sein-perfect-or-copula, de/copula-stays-apart).
schnell keeps its attributive sense used adverbially, so it stays ADJ (de/adjective-stays-adj).
In the state passive the participle is an ADJ describing a state (de/sein-perfect-or-copula, de/participial-adjective).
